layers.name: Orbit
layers.description: A sculptural ribbon in warm metallic light. A cinematic starting point for creative studios and personal brands.
layers.license: Original SCENE kit asset; editable community starter. No third-party artwork.
layers.prompt: Use the original Orbit layer as a foundation. Retain the procedural dimensional sculpture, controlled lighting, readable text-safe space, and static fallback. Create a distinct brand-appropriate composition, palette, typography, content hierarchy, and page flow. Explain why the abstract sculpture suits this brand; select a different motif if it doesn't. Keep semantic content independent of WebGL, preserve pause/reduced-motion behavior, cap rendering resolution, and test both desktop and mobile. Do not copy the fictional brand or invent business proof.

layers.name: Stillform
layers.description: A warm product stage with selectable finishes and deliberate shadows. Let the object carry the story.
layers.license: Original SCENE kit asset; editable community starter. No third-party artwork.
layers.prompt: Use the original Stillform layer as a starting point for a warm product-focused website. Preserve intentional object placement, dimensional framing, tactile colors, and accessible finish selection. Adapt the visible object to genuine supplied product material; label concept renders as illustrative and never present invented objects as actual inventory. Write original offer copy and connect only real purchase/inquiry destinations. Build relevant product, process, and contact sections. Preserve responsive, paused, and reduced-motion states.

layers.name: Index
layers.description: An editorial collection in perspective. Give a portfolio depth without burying the work.
layers.license: Original SCENE kit asset; editable community starter. No third-party artwork.
layers.prompt: Use the original Index layer for a distinctive portfolio or project-led business. Adapt the spatial card composition, hierarchy, palette, typography, and movement to the member. Replace demo project names with verified real work, or explicitly marked concepts. Keep project navigation accessible as normal HTML links, use a readable mobile sequence, and never require hover or dragging to access content. Add a concise positioning statement, useful project context, and a real contact action. Preserve pause and reduced-motion behavior.

layers.name: Statement
layers.description: Type becomes the main event. Oversized editorial composition with a tightly controlled rhythm.
layers.license: Original SCENE kit asset; editable community starter. No third-party artwork.
layers.prompt: Use the original Statement layer to make the member's positioning the visual subject. Write a concise truthful headline before choosing the type arrangement. Customize scale, line breaks, contrast, palette, and movement around the actual message. Keep readable content immediately available and avoid moving long body copy. Add meaningful offer/work/contact sections with varied editorial rhythm. Preserve keyboard access, mobile legibility, pause controls, and reduced-motion styles. This is kinetic typography, not WebGL 3D.

layers.name: Atrium
layers.description: Light, structure, and quiet depth. A considered alternative for service businesses and studios.
layers.license: Original SCENE kit asset; editable community starter. No third-party artwork.
layers.prompt: Use the original Atrium layer for a clear, reassuring service or studio website. Preserve the architectural sense of depth and light while adapting geometry, color, hierarchy, and content to the brand. Ground every service, location, claim, and credential in supplied or verified evidence. Use real imagery when it increases trust, with abstract architectural art clearly illustrative. Make the offer and booking/contact route obvious. Build useful service/process/proof/contact sections without invented testimonials, and preserve responsive, paused, and reduced-motion states.
